title: NSW SSD/SSI Application-Class Accuracy Instantiation and Temporal Allocation Qualification

application_class.decision_context: State Significant Development / State Significant Infrastructure aquifer-interference impact assessment
application_class.scope_boundary: A jurisdictional application class, not a claim about every individual NSW project or receptor.

purpose: Attempt one real external application-class instantiation of the canonical coupling application-accuracy contract. Qualify a numerical H_app and a numerical temporal allocation only if independently governed external evidence actually supplies those meanings. Otherwise fail closed without inventing policy.

H_app: Must be an externally governed numerical prediction-accuracy requirement or explicit numerical decision margin for the stated groundwater drawdown quantity of interest.
A physical impact threshold is not H_app merely because it is expressed in metres of drawdown.
Calibration residual targets, normalised RMSE targets, measurement uncertainty and solver closure tolerances are not H_app.
F-GC07 measured coupling error may not select H_app.
A_temporal: Must be independently supplied by an external application, regulator, project accuracy budget or governed decision rule as the permitted share of application prediction error allocated to coupling temporal error.
Stress-period or time-step guidance without an error allocation is not A_temporal.
F-GC07 convergence behaviour may test a supplied allocation but may not choose it.
admission_rules.H_temporal_budget: May be materialized only when both H_app and A_temporal pass their independent provenance gates; then H_temporal_budget = H_app * A_temporal.
admission_rules.mass_conservation: Absolute and outside any accuracy trade-off.

explicitly_rejected_shortcuts: NSW Level-1 0.2 m or 2 m drawdown threshold reused as H_app
5-10 percent normalised RMS calibration folklore reused as H_app
instrument or observation accuracy reused as prediction accuracy without a governed decision rule
using coupling-window convergence itself to back-calculate the application budget
